items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: And George Coleman. And I’m like oh man, that Miles, come on man, what are you doing man, who are these guys? Not realizing that this is the group that going to be called the second great quintet.

ctx.x: He couldn’t get anybody good, huh?

And George Coleman. And I’m like oh man, that Miles, come on man, what are you doing man, who are these guys? Not realizing that this is the group that going to be called the second great quintet. And so that’s what I remember about that concert, that I was very disappointed at first, but then when I heard them I said, well yeah, this might be okay — he had just put that group together — and the other thing I remember about that concert is how small the audience was. I was like where’s everybody? I mean what?…
Do you recall, beyond the music, noticing how they operate on stage? Visual cues, just watching the bass player interact with the drummer, was any of that apparent to you?
